title: Expand an audited infer-accept generate and gate spine
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, and works with the `audited_infer_accept` recipe. He wants a generate → freeze criteria → decide → independent QA → deterministic → gate control pattern that FOLK can migrate onto, without shipping Comfy in the library. Soft modality selects text decide/QA kinds; principals for decide and QA differ. Complements `fangore_verify_repair_recipe` (oracle loop) and `fangore_guided_coding_recipe` (which tiles this spine). He walks product steps (instantiate_recipe) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `audited_infer_accept` (`AuditedInferAcceptTemplate` + `append_audited_infer_accept`). Domain `mechaharness.audited_decision` (`STAGES`, `criteria_hash`, `assert_principals_distinct`, `repair_target`). Default node kinds `audited.*`; hosts soft-bind runners (FOLK: `folk.infer.*`). Migration notes: `docs/inspiration/folk-audited-infer-migration.md`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `spine.yaml`: environment + instantiate_recipe expects. Unit tests `tests/test_audited_decision.py`.
